lantern_post.name: Lantern Post
lantern_post.desc: Extends the campfire's glow. Only shines while the campfire burns.

bench.name: Log Bench
bench.desc: Sit by the fire. Resting here near a lit fire heals you a little faster.

fence.name: Wooden Fence
fence.desc: Keeps wolves and creatures from walking straight into camp.

storage_chest.name: Storage Chest
storage_chest.desc: Extra camp storage, shared with the crafting crate.

drying_rack.name: Drying Rack
drying_rack.desc: Turns raw meat into trail jerky over a day. Slow, but no fire needed.

spare_tent.name: Spare Tent
spare_tent.desc: A cozy spare tent. A tamed wolf will sleep here.

flower_planter.name: Flower Planter
flower_planter.desc: A pretty planter of wildflowers. Purely decorative.
